method: SHA-256 over fs.readFile raw Buffer bytes, not read-tool formatting or parsed/re-serialized archive JSON. Runtime hashes separately recomputed with installed viem keccak256 on archived hex code. No RPC or Forge run.

sourceFingerprint.qualification: The aggregate is retained as the command record identifier; no aggregate serialization algorithm is specified there. Independent verification uses the complete 50 path/byte/SHA-256 bindings rather than asserting a recomputed aggregate preimage.

baselineTest.qualification: Explicit historical baseline, not a claimed current test hash. Current strengthened test is separately bound to the accepted 13-case run.
